thread:
Anna: Heads-up — after the kernel-router change deployed to canary yesterday I'm seeing a 12% tail-latency regression on long-prefix Mixtral runs (>=8k). Looks correlated with heavy KV-cache usage.
Mike: Which router change exactly? the new 'prefer-fp8' kernel path? :eyes:
Anna: yes, router now prefers the smaller fused-kv kernel for newer models, falls back to legacy if shapes mismatch. Regression only shows up when prefix length > 2k and when RoPE scaling is non-default.
Jia: Can you paste the benchmark command + model meta?
Anna: repro command: ```python infra/perf/bench.py --model mixtral-7b --sequence 8192 --batch 1 --prefill 2048 --kernel-router canary --kv-cache enabled``` model_meta: ```n_heads: 32
kv_dim: 128
rope_scale: 1.04```
Anna: quick profiling snippet (nvprof summary): ```Kernel                            Calls  Total Time (ms)
fused_kv_kernel_v2               124    1120.3
legacy_kv_kernel                 34     282.6
attention_forward                158    640.9
other                            412    210.1```
Anna: under canary we see fused_kv_kernel_v2 dominating and ~18% higher per-call latency when prefix>2k vs prefill=0.
Ciara: suspicious. Could be extra IO for prefix copy -> quantization path. Did router enable fp8 encoding for prefills?
Anna: yes the policy was 'auto-quantize-kv' so prefills hit fp8 path.
Mike: if fp8 path does an on-the-fly dequant->compute->requant for eviction it's going to add churn. Any evidence of extra memcpy?
Anna: traces show extra device->device memcpy around eviction boundary. snippet from trace: ```[t=0.72s] memcpy D2D 512MB
[t=0.73s] dequantize_kv_fp8 -> alloc temp 64MB
[t=0.75s] compute fused_kv
[t=0.76s] requantize_kv_fp8 -> writeback 512MB```
Jia: that explains latency. Two ideas: 1) hybrid strategy: keep prefix in fp16/bf16 (no dequant roundtrip) and quantize only hot tail; 2) adjust eviction granularity to avoid frequent dequant cycles.
Ciara: We tried hybrid before on qwen workloads — memory drop ~28% and tail lat up only ~2% on avg. But rollout earlier showed accuracy delta ~0.6% on some eval prompts.
Mike: Can we measure perf vs quality for hybrid-perf?
Anna: ran local sweep: configs tested = [native-fp16, fp8-everything, hybrid-prefix-fp16-tail-fp8] results: ```native-fp16: gpu_mem=23.4GB, p99=120ms, eval-acc=100%
fp8-everything: gpu_mem=16.9GB, p99=138ms, eval-acc=99.1%
hybrid-prefix-fp16-tail-fp8: gpu_mem=17.8GB, p99=122ms, eval-acc=99.6%```
Anna: so hybrid recovers most latency with big memory win.
Jia: nice. How about eviction policy? current is LRU at per-head granularity; maybe use chunked MRU eviction to avoid touching prefills frequently.
Ciara: we also saw that RoPE scale !=1.0 caused alignment mismatch in the fused kernel's rotary indexing leading to additional per-head shuffles (extra kernel ops). That interacts poorly with fp8 because it forces intermediate buffers.
Mike: So root cause chain: router prefers fused fp8 kernel -> fused kernel expects specific head layout + rope scale path -> when scale!=1 it inserts shuffle ops + dequant/requant on eviction -> extra memcpy -> latency.
perf-bot: automated perf alert: canary cluster saw +11.7% p99 increase for mixtral-7b longprefix workloads between 2026-12-03T02:30Z and 2026-12-03T03:15Z.
Anna: Proposed immediate mitigation: revert router policy to prefer legacy-kv for profiles where prefix_mean > 1k OR rope_scale != 1.0. Roll forward plan: implement hybrid-prefix-fp16 + chunked-eviction and test canary.
Mike: 👍 Agree revert on canary and schedule A/B with hybrid config. Please open an issue with repro steps + perf numbers.
Jia: I'll PR a config patch: ```runtime:
  kv_cache:
    precision_policy: hybrid-prefix-fp16
    eviction: chunked-mru
    quantize_threshold_tokens: 2048```
Ciara: also add an opt-in flag for 'rope_aware_kernels' default=false so we don't force the extra shuffles until we have specialized kernels.
Anna: test plan: 1) revert router on canary; 2) run 12h perf sweep with sequence 512/2048/8192; 3) run eval suite for 10k prompts comparing tokens/ll diff; 4) create canary A/B with hybrid config.
Mike: ping @eng-sre for canary revert window.
Anna: created issue infra/rt-5293 and attached logs + perf traces. I'll push the revert CL now. :thumbsup:
Ciara: thanks — leaving notes for runtime team to prioritize kv evict+rope-aware kernel work next sprint.
perf-bot: note: trace artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/mixtral/1812345678/ for analysis.
Anna: will update thread with canary numbers after rollback.
